\# Removes the payment method types parameter from Checkout Sessions

\## What’s new

Removes the \[payment\_method\_types\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/create.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive#create\_checkout\_session-payment\_method\_types) parameter from the \[create Checkout Session\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/create.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive) method. You can no longer pass \`payment\_method\_types\` when you create a Checkout Session. Use \[dynamic payment methods\](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods/dynamic-payment-methods.md) to manage payment methods from the Dashboard without writing code.

You can also use \[excluded\_payment\_method\_types\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/create.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive#create\_checkout\_session-excluded\_payment\_method\_types) to exclude specific payment methods from the dynamic payment methods results or the new \[allowed\_payment\_method\_types\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/create.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive#create\_checkout\_session-allowed\_payment\_method\_types) parameter to specify a set of payment methods.

The \[allowed\_payment\_method\_types\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/create.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive#create\_checkout\_session-allowed\_payment\_method\_types) parameter accepts an array of payment method type and filters the list to only compatible payment methods based on other parameters such as \`currency\`, \`amount\`, and \`customer\`. The compatible subset is shown in the \[payment\_method\_types\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/object.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive#checkout\_session\_object-payment\_method\_types) property of the response.

Previously, \[payment\_method\_types\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/create.md?api-version=2026-08-26.dahlia#create\_checkout\_session-payment\_method\_types) returned an error when you specified an incompatible payment method. \`allowed\_payment\_method\_types\` silently filters out incompatible methods and returns only those that work with the current configuration.

\## Why is this a breaking change?

Passing \`payment\_method\_types\` as a parameter when you \[create a Checkout Session\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/create.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive) now returns a \`400\` error. If your integration sets this parameter, you must remove it and migrate to \[dynamic payment methods\](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods/dynamic-payment-methods.md) or \[allowed\_payment\_method\_types\](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/create.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive#create\_checkout\_session-allowed\_payment\_method\_types).

\## Impact

This migration requires careful attention if your integration passes \`payment\_method\_types\` when creating a Checkout Session. You must update your integration to use \[dynamic payment methods\](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods/dynamic-payment-methods.md) or switch to \`allowed\_payment\_method\_types\` to get automatic compatibility filtering instead of errors. Requests that include \`payment\_method\_types\` on this now return a \`400\` error.

entries.title: Removes the payment method types parameter from Checkout Sessions
entries.quote: Removes the `payment_method_types` parameter from the `create Checkout Session` method. You can no longer pass `payment_method_types` when you create a Checkout Session.
